channel.title: Work by Isaac Seiler
channel.description: Isaac Seiler is a tech generalist working across AI, public policy, education, research, and communications. Explore projects and experience across fields.

item.title: Leading AI Literacy Efforts in Taiwan
item.description: I pitched a local program for educators in Taiwan, then led six sessions and shared what we learned through OpenAI's education newsletter and an international conference.

item.title: Mapping the Rise of AI Across State Government
item.description: A public-information benchmark measuring how state and territory governments are actually responding to generative AI.

item.title: Raised $20k for Local St. Louis Organizations
item.description: A student-led philanthropy process that helped move real dollars to St. Louis nonprofits, including immigrant and refugee-serving organizations.

item.title: Investigating AI’s Impact on Journalism in Australia
item.description: A qualitative honors thesis on the structural decline of local journalism in Australia and its implications for democracy, labor, and media policy.

item.title: Bringing the Boehringer Cares Rebrand to Life
item.description: Implementing a new brand direction across the foundation's website, employee communications, and volunteering programs.

item.title: Building a Congressional Operation from Scratch
item.description: How I helped launch a congressional office and built its press network across local, statewide, and national media.
